title: Proactive reserve hedge and delta utilization auditor
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets occasionally see short, high-frequency microbursts that evade reactive autoscalers because provisioning latency is nontrivial. This leads to transient SLA slippage and increased tail latency for affected tenants. This PR implements two coordinated features: (1) a proactive 'reserve hedge' that maintains a small, configurable pool of warm slots computed per-pool and weighted by recent burstiness, and (2) a Delta Utilization Auditor that computes smoothed per-tenant utilization deltas and exports them so policy and SRE can audit headroom decisions.

What this changes (high level):
- Autoscaler strategy: add proactive_reserve.go which computes a soft reserve target using a burst metric (burst_rate, burst_variance) and a decay-weighted EWMA on delta-utilization. The reserve is advisory and will only be used when the cluster has spare capacity or when policy permits burst borrowing.
- Safety net: introduce a decaying credit pool (reserve_credits) that can be consumed by tenant bursts; credits decay if unused to avoid long-term overcommit.
- Telemetry: add delta_auditor.go to collect per-tenant utilization deltas, EWMA windows, and reserve consumption events; export new Prometheus metrics (redwood_reserve_target, redwood_reserve_consumed, redwood_delta_util_ewma) and a lightweight per-tenant HDR sketch summary for offline analysis.
- Operator flags and config: helm values and operator config support for reserve_hedge.enabled, reserve_hedge.target_fraction, reserve_hedge.decay_seconds, and reserve_hedge.max_credits_per_tenant.
- Rollout and safety: feature gate reserve_hedge.mode with values [off, observer, active]; observer mode only emits metrics and no allocation changes. Canary rollout plan added to deployment docs.

Checklist: [x] design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1123/proactive-reserve-hedge-design [x] unit tests for reserve math and decay behavior [x] integration test: simulated burst harness to validate no regressions in normal traffic [x] Prometheus metrics + dashboards stubbed [x] helm/operator config documented [x] canary rollout plan included in release notes

Integration harness simulating 1000 tenants with synthetic microbursts showed reserve consumption reduces observed tail latency by ~18% in canary runs. All checks green after fixes (build, unit, integ, lint).
